description: Issue #149 (layer L2): a repository whose tests live in a spec/ tree mirroring src/ — a layout the planner cannot derive from a path alone. The draft proposes it as a scope_companions rule with BOTH halves of the proof cited (the source file and the test file that mirrors it), never from the mere presence of a spec/ directory: `spec/routing_spec.rb` is scanned FIRST and skipped, because no src/ app/ lib/ file pairs with it, and a rule drafted from it would be a guess. A second layout under test/ does pair, so the draft declares the first in scan order and warns about the other rather than silently picking one.
